research.title: Support Request Classification with Sparse Text Baselines
bullets: Prepared support request text by removing duplicate messages, normalizing formatting, and checking category labels against supplied annotation guidelines.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines, evaluated macro-averaged classification metrics, and inspected confusion patterns among overlapping request categories.

research.title: Sentence-Level Uncertainty Detection in Scientific Abstracts
bullets: Segmented scientific abstracts into sentences, standardized uncertainty annotations, and maintained document-level splits to prevent sentences from crossing evaluation partitions.
Implemented keyword and linear classifier baselines using lexical features, then reviewed false positives involving negation and speculative phrasing.

work.title: Routine Office Operations Support
bullets: Maintained supply inventories, checked incoming deliveries against purchase records, and routed discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Organized routine paperwork, coordinated meeting room reservations, and tracked outstanding service requests through established office procedures.

projects.title: Extractive Document Summarization with TF-IDF Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented a baseline extractive summarizer that ranked sentences by similarity to a TF-IDF document centroid and retained original sentence order.
Compared selected sentences with reference summaries using unigram overlap, and examined failures involving repeated content and missing contextual information.
